_comment_fallback: fallback recipe used when no specific recipe is registered for a rule_id

fallback.description: Fallback NOOP — marks rule as SKIPPED when no specific recipe exists

DUMMY_TEST_RULE.description: E2E dummy recipe — appends // E2E TEST comment

DEQUE_LINKEDLIST_RETROFIT.description: LinkedList already implements Deque in Java 6 — informational only

NAVIGABLE_SET_MAP.description: TreeSet/TreeMap already implement NavigableSet/NavigableMap in Java 6 — informational only

DIAMOND_OPERATOR.description: Replace explicit generic type arguments with diamond operator <>

STRINGS_IN_SWITCH.description: Convert .equals() if-else chains to switch statements

THREAD_STOP_DISABLED.description: Inspect .stop() calls flagged for Thread.stop(Throwable) disabled in Java 8; mark custom .stop() methods as SKIPPED

LAMBDA_CONVERSION.description: Convert anonymous SAM classes to Java 8 lambda expressions

CORBA_REMOVAL.description: Delete the CORBA dependency: remove the generated FIPA IDL stubs, the jade.mtp.iiop transport and their build.xml wiring, instead of retrofitting an external ORB

STRING_ISEMPTY_ADOPTION.description: Replace String.length() == 0 with String.isEmpty() where the receiver is proven to be a String

ARRAYS_COPYOF_FULL_ARRAY_COPY.description: Replace the full-array System.arraycopy idiom with java.util.Arrays.copyOf

_comment_corba_variants: CORBA_REMOVAL has two mutually exclusive recipes. This branch (work/jump-811) maps it to jade-recipe-8-11-corba-removal (mode agent), which deletes the generated FIPA IDL stubs and the IIOP MTP. The fallback path, used by the jade-8-to-11 run on master, is jade-recipe-8-11-corba-retrofit (mode script, .claude/skills/java-migration-skill-registry/8-to-11/jade-recipe-8-11-corba-retrofit/scripts/apply.py), which adds GlassFish CORBA jars to the classpath and changes no source. That recipe is left untouched on disk. To switch back, replace the CORBA_REMOVAL entry with {skill, script, description} pointing at it and drop the mode key. Never run both against the same workspace.

TLS_ANON_CIPHER_DISABLED.description: Resolve hard-coded anonymous TLS cipher suites (DH_anon/ECDH_anon) disabled by the JDK 11 default jdk.tls.disabledAlgorithms

CLDR_LOCALE_DATA_DEFAULT.description: Make date/time formatting independent of the default locale data provider, which switched from JRE/COMPAT to CLDR in JDK 9

TRY_WITH_RESOURCES.description: Convert manual open/close to try-with-resources only where the resource is Closeable, closed on every path, and unused after the block

_comment_11_to_17: The 11-to-17 bucket is agent-mode only. The jump has one build blocker (RMIC_TOOL_REMOVED); the other four rules are deprecation work that compiles unchanged on 17, so each recipe carries an explicit stop condition rather than a blanket transform.

RMIC_TOOL_REMOVED.description: Delete the two Ant <rmic> pregeneration steps; the rmic tool was removed in JDK 15 and UnicastRemoteObject generates stubs dynamically

WRAPPER_CONSTRUCTOR_DEPRECATED_FOR_REMOV.description: Replace primitive wrapper constructors with the valueOf factories deprecated for removal by JEP 390, skipping identity-sensitive sites

APPLET_API_DEPRECATED_FOR_REMOVAL.description: Resolve JADE's java.applet.Applet dependency, deprecated for removal by JEP 398; the retire-or-suppress decision is escalated

MULTICAST_SOCKET_GROUP_API_DEPRECATED.description: Move multicast discovery off the deprecated MulticastSocket.joinGroup/leaveGroup(InetAddress) overloads superseded in JDK 17

THREADGROUP_DESTROY_DEPRECATED_FOR_REMOV.description: Remove the terminally deprecated ThreadGroup.destroy() call in jade.core.Runtime while preserving the shutdown diagnostic
